description: Creates a media record and returns the URL(s) to PUT the file to; the URLs stop working after 11 hours. After the PUT (after the last part, for multipart) call upload_get_import_job_state until it reports ready: that also assembles a multipart upload. For a file that is already online, use upload_import_from_url.

mimeType.description: e.g. video/mp4. The PUT must send it as Content-Type.

multipart.description: true: one URL per part. Files over 5 GB always get parts. Default false: one PUT.

name: upload_get_upload_url
title: Get an upload URL
